title: Make world-query visibility and DM-only fields explicit
description: World records include DM-only information such as secrets. Make public vs DM-only fields explicit in world-query results and downstream context/trace handling so hidden information is not accidentally surfaced to a future player-facing UI or export.
acceptance_criteria:
- World-query result shape distinguishes public and DM-only data.
- Prompt assembly intentionally handles DM-only data.
- Player-visible exports or UI-facing paths do not accidentally include DM-only fields.
- Tests cover at least one record with hidden/secret data.
close_reason: PR #86 adds visibility/dmOnlyFields to WorldQueryResult + toPlayerSafeView projection
